item.title: 5 appear in court in relation to Monaghan public order incident
item.description: Five men have appeared before Monaghan Circuit Court today in relation to a violent disorder that took place in Monaghan Town. The incident that involved at least 10 men occurred outside McConnon’s Londis in Monaghan Town on April of 2024. All five appeared this afternoon at Monaghan Circuit Court in relation to this incident that lasted for 2 minutes at Old Cross Square almost two years ago. item.title: Castle Leslie Estate wins national hotel award
item.description: The Castle Leslie Estate in Co Monaghan has won the overall prize this year’s Gold Medal Awards. The annual awards aims to recognise and celebrate the outstanding achievements of the hospitality industry from across the country. Now in its 36th year, the glitzy ceremony took place on Tuesday evening at the Galmont Hotel & Spa in Galway. Advertisement The overall winner was Castle Leslie Estate, Co. item.title: Local road remained closed overnight
item.description: The R187 in Co Monaghan has remained closed overnight following a collision. Gardai remain at the scene of what has been described as a serious road traffic collision on the R187 near Inishammon. It occurred late yesterday evening close to the border. Advertisement Gardai say local diversions are in place.

item.title: Man dies in fatal Co Monaghan collision
item.description: Northern Sound News understands a man has died in a road collision in Co Monaghan. The R187 in Co Monaghan has remained closed overnight following the collision. Gardai remain at the scene of what Gardai has described as a serious road traffic collision on the R187 near Inishammon, Smithboro. The incident occurred late yesterday evening close to the border. Gardai have yet to confirm the fatality and they say local diversions are in place. Advertisement

item.title: Investigation underway following serious dog attack
item.description: An investigation's underway after an infant boy was seriously injured in a dog-attack in County Kilkenny yesterday. Two dogs have been seized by the Dog Warden and arrangements are being made to have them euthanised. The child was rushed to Children's Health Ireland, in Crumlin in Dublin - where he's being treated for serious, but not life-threatening injuries. Advertisement Gardai say the scene, at Callan, has been preserved for technical examination.

item.title: Perfect professional start for Shane Mc Guirk
item.description: Shane Mc Guirk has qualified for his first televised professional tournament since securing his PDC tour card earlier this month. The Monaghan darts player will take to the Oche tonight (Thursday) in the Winamu World Masters on ITV 4 where he will face Nathan Aspinall. Shane came through the preliminary rounds yesterday defeating a number of high profile players along the way including Cameron Menzies, Scottie Waites and fellow Irish player Keane Barry. item.description: Gardaí and emergency services attended the scene of a fatal single-vehicle road traffic collision involving a car, at Inishammon, Smithboro, Co. Monaghan, on Wednesday 28th January 2026. The collision, on the R187 between Monaghan and Rosslea, occurred at approximately 7.30pm. The sole occupant of the car, a man aged in his 30’s, was pronounced deceased at the scene.
